_comment: Contract templates. Nulls and bracketed values are deliberate: acceptance criteria, timing budgets, evidence and review must come from a documented review, not from this file's author. No detector here is validated.

contracts.intended_use: The user asks for help with the command 'Guardian, emergency help.'

operating_envelope.requires: the app running in the foreground or an approved background mode

failure_modes: app suspended by the operating system
contracts.trigger_rule: an exact match of a supported help command from the app session
contracts.clearing_rule: the user cancels, or the emergency workflow reaches RESOLVED
contracts.degraded_behavior: if the app cannot act, say so at once and point to the phone's native emergency call

contracts.intended_use: A check-in the user scheduled is not acknowledged before its deadline.

operating_envelope.requires: the app allowed to run its timer in the background

failure_modes: timer suspended by the operating system
contracts.degraded_behavior: if the timer cannot run in the background, report that check-ins are unavailable

contracts.intended_use: An input, permission or output channel the configured scope depends on stops being healthy.
failure_modes: the app itself suspended, which it cannot report
contracts.trigger_rule: an input goes stale, a permission is revoked, or an output route fails
contracts.clearing_rule: the input, permission or route is healthy again and re-verified
contracts.degraded_behavior: report the specific capability lost; keep unaffected functions

contracts.intended_use: Relay a fall or crash event reported by the phone or watch platform's own detector.
contracts.trigger_rule: a platform fall event observation, admitted by the observation gate
contracts.clearing_rule: the user responds to the check-in
contracts.degraded_behavior: report that fall detection is unavailable

contracts.intended_use: Relay an official localized emergency warning delivered by the platform's alert system.
failure_modes: no coverage from the issuing system
contracts.trigger_rule: a platform warning observation, admitted by the observation gate
contracts.clearing_rule: the warning expires or is withdrawn by its issuer
contracts.degraded_behavior: report that official warnings are not being relayed

contracts.intended_use: Warn of an observable obstacle in the path covered by a forward-facing wearable camera.
contracts.degraded_behavior: say 'Visual detection unavailable. Camera blocked.' and keep other functions
